a.text: Heads up before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building to 8 means we are both very likely caught short by the first storm. The reserve holds only 4 now, so only one of us can be safe in round 1. I don't want to break our agreement unilaterally. Do you want to stick with operating, or renegotiate? Tell me your plan and I'll honor whatever we settle on openly.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep the agreement and operate with you. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
